cultural.vision_reason: The photo shows a line of women and a child carrying baskets on their heads along a rural path, matching a documentary daily-life scene captioned as Anga women "going to market," consistent with the claimed people's dress and activity.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, medium group of Plain Anga adult females and child "going to market". Walking in line along path, carrying baskets of goods [?] on heads. Wearing aprons attached to belts. Rural setting.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
